description: Hi! I am Sadia Sultana Iqra, lead of Team AstroHelix. I specialize in space biology , neuroscience , AI/ML, data analysis , UI/UX and science storytelling. I am building AstroHelix, an AI powered bio-resilience framework using NASA datasets to protect astronauts from neural and DNA damage . Joining AstroHelix means shaping the future of space biology , turning bio-data into life saving technology for future mission.
